remarks: This cozy main-level 1-bedroom apartment in a single-family home with private entrance, offers a beautiful atmosphere and plenty of storage space. This open concept unit offers modern appliances, hardwood floors, central air conditioning, and in-unit laundry. Natural light streams in through windows, creating a bright and inviting space. Enjoy a covered front porch, perfect for relaxation. One off-street parking space is included, with additional parking available for a fee. Located in the quiet Silvermine neighborhood, and conveniently located close to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. No pets allowed and good credit is required. The owner reserves the right to interview potential tenants.
